fmakv2-1000.purpose: External validation of global key detection
fmakv2-1000.audio_license: Per-track Creative Commons licenses recorded by FMA
fmakv2-1000.selection: The 1,000 lowest SHA-256 ranks of namespace and track ID
limitations: S-KEY training data is not fully disclosed, so pretraining overlap cannot be ruled out.
FMAKv2 has been used in published key-detection research.
This result must be described as external validation, not a clean held-out model comparison.

fsl10k-1000.purpose: External loop-domain validation of global tempo detection
fsl10k-1000.audio_license: Per-sound Creative Commons licenses recorded in FSL10K metadata
fsl10k-1000.selection: Sounds with at least two usable annotations agreeing within 1 BPM, followed by the 1,000 lowest SHA-256 ranks of namespace and sound ID
limitations: The corpus contains loops rather than complete songs.
The result measures steady-loop tempo and cannot establish full-song beat-tracking quality.
Potential pretraining overlap is not documented by the compared model authors.

gtzan-rhythm.reason: Official audio is no longer distributed, and the audited annotation repository has no explicit license. An unofficial audio mirror would not meet the provenance gate.
